title: BCTC Q1-2026 ingestion remediation — 5 blocker fix sequence

decisions.a_sequence_reasoning: Pattern bug (#1) is upstream root — without VPS discovering PDFs, no other fix matters for the 34 SSC-URL rows. OCR (#4) is independent parallel track for 4 already-pulled PDFs (GAS/EIB/DHG/FPT). Sweep (#5) is next-quarter insurance, not Q1-2026 critical. URL-filter widening (#3) is moot if #1 caches PDFs at /bctc-files/ — defer as fallback. #2 jq error LOW, bundle with #1.
decisions.b_vps_script_repo_location: discover-bctc-urls-browser.py is VPS-ONLY (not in repo). fetch-bctc.sh IS in repo at vps-scripts/fetch-bctc.sh. deploy-vinahost.sh at scripts/deploy-vinahost.sh handles VPS service deploy but does NOT push discover-bctc-urls-browser.py. Owner dev-vps-crawls must either (i) add discover script to repo + extend deploy-vinahost.sh, OR (ii) SSH-edit on VPS (faster, lower risk for 1-line fix). PO recommends (ii) for speed + (i) as follow-up CLEAN task.
decisions.c_sprint_scoping: ONE sprint (1953). 'Ship completion' = Q1-2026 watchlist coverage ≥75%. Split tasks for parallelism (1953a + 1953d run concurrent), not for slicing.
decisions.d_acceptance_criterion: Within 48h of last task deploy: ≥75% (26 of 34) watchlist tickers have Q1-2026 row in financial_reports table. Verification query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) FROM financial_reports WHERE period_year=2026 AND period_quarter='Q1'.

task_sequence.title: Fix discover-bctc-urls-browser.py zero-padded quarter pattern + fetch-bctc.sh jq error
task_sequence.scope: 1-line fix to matches_quarter_and_year() patterns array: add 'quý 01','quý 02','quý 03','quý 04' (or regex r'qu[yý] 0?[1-4]'). Bundle with fetch-bctc.sh jq guard (QUEUE empty check before pipe). SSH directly to Vinahost /root/ for speed. Follow-up CLEAN task to commit discover script to repo.
task_sequence.verification: python3 /root/discover-bctc-urls-browser.py ACB 2026 Q1 returns JSON with .results[0].url pointing to PDF. After 6h auto-cycle, /root/bctc-cache/ACB/ has Q1-2026 PDF.

task_sequence.title: Restore poppler-utils + tesseract-ocr in mcp-server container
task_sequence.scope: Verify apps/mcp-server/Dockerfile has poppler-utils + tesseract-ocr in apt-get install line (runbook claims 2026-04-27 add — confirm not lost in rebuild). Rebuild + redeploy container. Re-trigger bctcReparseJob for 3 stranded feedback rows (EIB/FPT/DHG Q1-2026) + GAS.
task_sequence.verification: docker exec mcp-server which pdftoppm && which tesseract returns paths. bctcReparseJob next cycle extracts ≥1 of 4 stranded Q1-2026 PDFs to financial_reports row.

task_sequence.title: Audit bctcBatchSweepJob registration + recordJobRun wiring
task_sequence.scope: Why no cron_job_runs record for 2026-04-25 09:00 UTC kickoff? Two hypotheses: (i) job not registered in startScheduler.ts at that time, (ii) recordJobRun not called. Audit src/scheduler/financial-reports/bctcBatchSweepJob.ts + cronConfig.ts + startScheduler.ts. Fix wiring if broken. Add unit test asserting recordJobRun is called.
task_sequence.verification: Manual trigger of bctcBatchSweepJob writes 1 row to cron_job_runs with status='success'. Q2-2026 sweep 2026-07-25 will fire correctly.
task_sequence.note: Not Q1-2026-critical — 1953a recovers Q1 via existing enricher loop. This is Q2+ insurance.

task_sequence.title: CLEAN — commit discover-bctc-urls-browser.py to vps-scripts/ + extend deploy-vinahost.sh
task_sequence.scope: Pull /root/discover-bctc-urls-browser.py from VPS into vps-scripts/discover-bctc-urls-browser.py. Add scp line in deploy-vinahost.sh. Eliminates VPS-only drift risk for future fixes.
task_sequence.verification: scripts/deploy-vinahost.sh idempotent re-deploy leaves /root/discover-bctc-urls-browser.py byte-identical to repo copy.

task_sequence.title: FALLBACK — widen bctcPdfPullJob URL filter OR fix enricher to rewrite SSC→VPS URLs
task_sequence.scope: ONLY trigger this task if 1953a verification at 48h shows >5 SSC-URL queue rows still pending. Option A: widen bctcPdfPullJob.ts:238 SQL to handle both VPS and SSC URLs (downloads SSC directly host-side — risk: geo-block from host). Option B: fix bctcQueueEnricher to rewrite SSC URLs into VPS-format once VPS caches the file (lower risk).
task_sequence.verification: After fix: 0 SSC-URL queue rows with attempts=0 after 24h. All pending rows touched by pull job.
task_sequence.trigger_condition: 1953a deployed AND 48h observation shows >5 idle SSC-URL rows

sprint_done_when_all_met: AC-1: 1953a deployed — python3 /root/discover-bctc-urls-browser.py ACB 2026 Q1 returns valid PDF URL (pattern fix verified).
AC-2: 1953b deployed — docker exec mcp-server which pdftoppm && which tesseract both return paths.
AC-3: At 48h post-AC-1+AC-2 deploy: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) FROM financial_reports WHERE period_year=2026 AND period_quarter='Q1' >= 26 (≥75% of 34-stock watchlist).
AC-4: 1953c — cron_job_runs has ≥1 row for bctcBatchSweepJob after manual trigger.
AC-5: 1953d — vps-scripts/discover-bctc-urls-browser.py exists in repo + deploy-vinahost.sh deploys it.
AC-6 (conditional): If 1953e triggered → 0 SSC-URL queue rows with attempts=0 at 24h.

risk_notes: 1953a SSH-direct edit creates short-term drift between repo and VPS — 1953d closes that window.
1953b Dockerfile claims OCR deps added 2026-04-27 — if true, container was rebuilt from stale image. Verify build cache / image tag.
1953e Option A (host-side SSC download) risks geo-block — that's why all VN sources go through Vinahost VPS (see memory: project_bctc_vps_proxy.md). Option B preferred.
Per CLAUDE.md 'Ship completion, not slices': do not declare sprint DONE until AC-3 coverage gate (≥75%) is met.
next_action: Dispatch dev-vps-crawls with 1953a (lowest-risk, highest-impact, unblocks 34 tickers, ~30min SSH edit + verification).
